name: When should I call a professional for water intrusion?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for water intrusion?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for water intrusion as soon as you notice any persistent signs of a leak or water damage. If you're unsure about the source, the extent of the damage, or how to properly fix it, a professional general contractor can accurately diagnose the problem and provide a lasting solution. Early intervention by experts prevents minor issues from becoming major, costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional immediately if you notice persistent signs of a leak or water damage, especially if you're unsure of the source or extent.
